testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/verify-place-order-with-invoice-me-payment-method-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > verify place order with invoice me payment method for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered retail user signs in, adds a configurable product (quantity 5) to the cart, checks out with the account default address and Custom Flat Rate shipping, pays with Invoice Me and places the order; the receipt thank-you banner is checked.
steps: Start with an empty storageState and sign in with the dedicated retail account (username/password from the test data).
Search the configurable product SKU, open its result, set quantity 5, add to cart and open the cart.
Proceed to checkout from the cart (the account default address is used) and select Ship Complete + Custom Flat Rate shipping.
Remove the auto-applied voucher if its number matches voucherNumberData.
Place the order and check the 'Thank You For Your Purchase' receipt banner.
stateChanges: Registered user's cart filled with the configurable product
A new order is placed for the user (Invoice Me)
assertions: Receipt banner visible and equals orderReceiptText ('Thank You For Your Purchase').
evidence: Title 'verify place order with invoice me payment method for retail user' matches the flow: signed-in retail user, configurable product, Invoice Me payment, order placed.
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).

configurableProduct B-100000 is searched and opened by its parent SKU and added with the default variant (no variant picked) at quantity 5: PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS, minVariants 1, quantityUsed 5, output parentProductSku. Other profile run: B-100000 is an active PRODUCTION ConfigurableProduct (Philips); variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology as in the approved PDP/cart entries for it.

DOUBT: the spec relies on the account already having a default shipping/billing address (checkout goes straight to shipping); USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain that. A key (or param) for a registered user with a default address is missing.

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete and then lblShippingMethodFLAT (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE with shippingCode FLAT. Destination country assumed 'us' (the address is masked or is the account's default address); assumption.

voucherNumberData '1QGSS8ZG6B' is passed to removeVoucherByNumberIfPresent: the test removes an auto-applied voucher only when its number equals this value. It is a defensive clean-up setting (config), not a record the test needs; no vocabulary key covers vouchers. If another voucher is auto-applied it stays on the order.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (same as the approved shopping-cart and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
Profile (atstage 2026-10-31) has no observations for this spec: every source is profiled false.
MISSING KEY: the test needs Invoice Me payment active on the store and offered to the registered user's profile; no vocabulary key covers it, so the need is left out.

swap: data only through loadData (configurableProduct -> product.parentProductSku; credentials are kept, not swapped), no derived assertions (fixed UI text only), no data value in the spec code, no other data file.
